provenance.what: capacity probe only -- no arms, no coverage table, no MDE
provenance.why: the worker writes its blob only when the sweep ends; it was replaced at 46/80 arms, so this measurement would otherwise have been lost
provenance.precision: base and floor are the log 2-decimal prints, so each recovery is accurate to about 0.2 points (0.06 for 3B, whose Gamma is narrow) and the spread to 0.3; the G3.0 threshold is 15.0, so the rounding cannot change the verdict
